capabilities.title: Deterministic smoke validation
capabilities.notes: The minimal deterministic barrier that proves replay-backed eval execution still works end to end.

capabilities.title: Context drift detection
capabilities.notes: Strict artifact-context drift remains advisory until the baseline stops producing event-family drift under release-candidate execution.

capabilities.title: Artifact-backed context coverage
capabilities.notes: This capability intentionally uses both strict and relaxed selected-invariant cases because transcript drift and artifact-source drift matter independently.

capabilities.title: Approval workflow
capabilities.notes: Curated replay evidence covers an approved apply_patch request from ApprovalRequested through ApprovalResolved, resumed execution, and completed assistant output. Denial-specific UX and live dashboard resolution behavior remain covered by focused integration tests.

capabilities.title: Ask-user workflow
capabilities.notes: Curated replay evidence covers an ask_user request through UserQuestionAsked, UserAnswerProvided, and answer-aware assistant resumption. Operator timing, empty-answer validation, and UI-specific error states remain focused integration evidence.

capabilities.title: Dashboard action semantics
capabilities.notes: Replay protects the canonical approval and answer events that dashboard actions write. Dashboard-origin metadata is not persisted yet, so HTTP route behavior, optimistic UI, and live daemon transport remain focused integration or frontend evidence.

capabilities.title: Daemon attach persisted-event contract
capabilities.notes: Replay protects the persisted event history that attach and reconnect flows consume. Live daemon process health, sockets, and stale-owner recovery remain integration and release-smoke evidence.

capabilities.title: Operator cancellation evidence
capabilities.notes: Advisory fixtures prove model-call, tool-execution, and repeated/reconnect-sensitive local cancellation evidence replays explicitly rather than as generic failures. Provider remote-computation stop behavior and live socket timing remain advisory or integration evidence.

capabilities.title: Task-plan proposal capture
capabilities.notes: GBX-950 classifies this as split-before-promotion. Advisory v8 replay evidence protects the normalized task-plan projection, but the current compact cancelled-turn bundle should not become blocking release evidence. Release blocking still depends on existing task-plan unit, integration, export/import, and dashboard coverage until a smaller non-cancelled projection invariant exists.

capabilities.title: Task continuation until blocked
capabilities.notes: GBX-950 keeps this advisory. Advisory v8 replay evidence records the bounded stop reason, but daemon-owned continuation timing, pause/resume, cancellation, and stale-owner recovery remain integration and manual release evidence until a smaller deterministic stop-contract case exists.

capabilities.title: Autonomy budget exhaustion
capabilities.notes: GBX-951 promotes this into release-candidate evidence. The replay case protects deterministic budget posture and exhaustion reason while focused policy and web tests remain the release authority for live budget decisions.

capabilities.title: Verify-repair success evidence
capabilities.notes: GBX-951 promotes this into release-candidate evidence. The replay case retains successful verification-loop projection. Actual command execution and repair limits remain covered by focused verification-loop tests.

capabilities.title: Verify-repair failure evidence
capabilities.notes: GBX-951 promotes this into release-candidate evidence. The replay case retains failed verification-loop projection and residual stop state. Actual command failure handling remains covered by focused verification-loop tests.

capabilities.title: Workspace-memory context drift
capabilities.notes: GBX-950 keeps this advisory. Workspace-memory prompt-source drift remains advisory because freshness and invalidation depend on local workspace state. Focused context and memory tests remain the stronger blocking evidence.

capabilities.title: Repository-index context drift
capabilities.notes: GBX-950 keeps this advisory. Repository-index prompt-source drift remains advisory because index freshness depends on local file state. Focused repository-index tests and rebuild smoke remain the stronger blocking evidence.

capabilities.title: Branch-search candidate comparison
capabilities.notes: GBX-951 promotes this into release-candidate evidence. The replay case retains deterministic candidate comparison summaries. Live branch creation, cleanup, and selection remain integration and manual release evidence.

capabilities.title: Incomplete-turn recovery boundaries
capabilities.notes: GBX-1090 adds deterministic fixture evidence for incomplete-turn recovery decisions so process-local interruption does not become invisible release risk.

capabilities.title: Checkpoint resume recovery
capabilities.notes: GBX-1090 records checkpoint and resume outcome posture as deterministic release-candidate evidence.

capabilities.title: Context compaction provenance
capabilities.notes: GBX-1090 protects compaction source provenance as release-candidate evidence without asserting exact generated prose.

capabilities.title: Stale compaction exclusion
capabilities.notes: GBX-1090 records stale compaction exclusion beside active compaction evidence so resume context stays bounded.

capabilities.title: Tool-attempt partial-output retention
capabilities.notes: GBX-1090 records partial tool output and heartbeat evidence as release-candidate replay context.

capabilities.title: Tool-attempt safe retry classification
capabilities.notes: GBX-1090 protects safe-to-retry classification for stale or interrupted tool attempts.

capabilities.title: Stale verification warning
capabilities.notes: GBX-1090 records stale verification posture beside the task plan so long work cannot continue on hidden stale evidence.

capabilities.title: Long-run cockpit summary
capabilities.notes: GBX-1090 records progress, budget, checkpoint, and recovery posture that the cockpit is expected to summarize.
